subject: Shiny server does not update rda

messages.author: c2959b3cda9ef153
messages.subject: Shiny server does not update rda
parts:
Hi,

I am running an application which loads several .rda files on global.R

It worked perfectly when I created them firstly but after I updated those rdas, the application loads the updated rdas when it is run "locally" on the server (i.e., through the localhost on the 8787 port) but NOT on the public address on the 3838 port.

Any ideas? I already tried restarting shiny-server, Rstudio and even the VM with no success. 

I also tried this http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#restarting-an-application

PS: I don't get any error message

Cheers,

Hernan
